samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>Implement a traffic light with three outputs: red, yellow, and green. These represent the states of the road lanes, while another lane (sidewalk) has two LEDs: green and red. The red LED indicates that pedestrians can cross, while the green LED indicates that vehicles can pass. There is also a pedestrian button. In normal operation, the road lane indicator changes its color to green after 60 clock cycles, then turns to yellow for 5 clock cycles, and finally turns to red for 10 clock cycles. When the pedestrian button is pressed, the road lane indicator changes its color to green after 60 clock cycles, then turns to yellow for 5 clock cycles, but the number of clock cycles for red depends on whether there are more than 10 clock cycles left to change the color to green. If there are more than 10 clock cycles, the red LED turns off and changes to green after 60 clock cycles, otherwise it stays red until the end of the cycle.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="pass_request">Input for requesting permission to pass.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <output id="green">Green LED output for the road lane.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow LED output for the road lane.</output>
        <output id="red">Red LED output for the road lane.</output>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter for tracking clock cycles.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="idle">Initial state of the traffic light controller.</parameter>
        <parameter name="s1_red">State indicating the red light is turned on for the road lane.</parameter>
        <parameter name="s2_yellow">State indicating the yellow light is turned on for the road lane.</parameter>
        <parameter name="s3_green">State indicating the green light is turned on for the road lane.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" type="internal">Internal counter for managing clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="state" type="internal">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        
        <reg id="p_red" type="internal">Next value for the red LED.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow" type="internal">Next value for the yellow LED.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green" type="internal">Next value for the green LED.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                state <= idle;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    idle: begin
                        state <= s1_red;
                    end
                    s1_red: begin
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if(cnt == 8'd3) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        state <= idle;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic for the internal counter (cnt)
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                if(pass_request && green) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end else begin
                    if(green && !p_green) begin
                        cnt <= 8'd60;
                    end else if(yellow && !p_yellow) begin
                        cnt <= 8'd5;
                    end else if(red && !p_red) begin
                        cnt <= 8'd10;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt - 8'd1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        assign clock = cnt;
        
        // Output assignments
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                {red, yellow, green} <= {1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0};
            end else begin
                {red, yellow, green} <= {p_red, p_yellow, p_green};
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    <task>
        <title>Task Description</title>
        <text>
            Task ID: 1
            Input Ports:
                - pass_request
                - rst_n
                - clk
            Output Ports:
                - green
                - yellow
                - red
                - clock
            Internal Registers/Wires:
                - cnt
                - state
                - p_red
                - p_yellow
                - p_green
            Description:
            The task is to implement a traffic light system. Given the inputs pass_request, rst_n, and clk, generate the outputs green, yellow, red, and clock. Utilize the internal registers/wires cnt, state, p_red, p_yellow, and p_green to manage the traffic light operations. Ensure proper synchronization and timing.
        </text>
    </task>
</module>
